title: Add 'keep me logged in' option
description: As a shopper I want to stay logged in on my device for 30 days so that I don't have to sign in every time.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Keep me logged in' checkbox appears on the sign-in page
When checked, the user stays signed in for 30 days
When unchecked, the session ends when the browser closes
_note: Changes authentication/session behavior but uses no rules.py keywords. Tests the LLM without the rule override.
